item.title: [SwiftHFR] CI: pre-commit config and job, ShellCheck on shell scripts
item.body:
Closes #142
Closes #390
Claim: cloud/ci-precommit

**Problem.** No pre-commit config and no CI check on YAML/JSON syntax, private keys or shell scripts; ShellCheck had only been run by hand.

**Cause.** Never set up; the shell scripts (`scripts/*.sh`, `tooling/legacy-oracle/run-oracle.sh`) were never linted.

**Change.**
- `.pre-commit-config.yaml`: `pre-commit-hooks` v6.0.0 (check-yaml, check-json outside fixtures, merge conflicts, large files, private keys) and `shellcheck-py` v0.11.0.1 (all `*.sh` and shebang scripts). No formatting hook, so fixtures stay byte-exact.
- `ci.yml`: new `pre-commit` job (`pre-commit==4.7.0`, `setup-python` pinned by SHA) running `pre-commit run --all-files`.
- `run-oracle.sh`: SC2015 fixed (`rm -rf` then `mkdir || die`); SC2329 (function used by `trap`) and SC1003 (literal `\` spinner frame) justified inline.
- CONTRIBUTING.md §4 documents the pinned versions.
- No ADR: dev-time CI tooling, not an app or engine dependency (AGENTS.md §3); both issues ask for it explicitly.

**Checked.** `pre-commit run --all-files` passes locally on the branch. Failing case (a ShellCheck error fails the job) is shown below on a throwaway commit.

Failing case (the PR body says "below"): shown locally rather than on a throwaway commit. A tracked `scripts/_tmp.sh` with `echo $1; rm -rf $2/` made `pre-commit run --all-files` fail on the shellcheck hook (SC2086, SC2115, exit 1); the job runs the same command, so it fails the same way. File removed, nothing committed.
